design_intent.summary: A large vertical wizard observation tower inspired by a crooked stone lighthouse: heavy block-built stone base, narrow rising shaft, asymmetric timber balconies, projecting lantern arm, and a large glazed observatory crown. The structure must read clearly from an RTS camera while remaining fully traversable through authored paths.
visual_rules: Use projecting balconies and buttresses to break the silhouette.
Keep the main vertical core readable from distance.
The glazed observatory crown must be the strongest silhouette.
All traversal remains authored; never infer it from rendered mesh.

implementation_notes: Do not fill the entire bounding volume with cubes; instantiate only authored regions.
The tower must taper upward and expand again at the observatory crown.
Stairs must be visibly generated as block steps, not invisible-only links.
Gate collision and gate navigation must switch together through main_gate_open.
Balconies are deliberate silhouette breaks and should remain even if decorative meshes evolve.
The observatory may use rounded visual dressing later, but its gameplay floor remains authored and rectangular.

reserved_airspace.reason: Protect observatory silhouette from nearby generated structures.

world_rules.origin_rule: Local origin is the south-west-bottom corner.

notes: The open central atrium reveals units on both levels.
Heavy units remain on the laboratory floor.

design_intent.summary: A gothic barracks laboratory with a broad muster entrance, two specimen islands, a six-block central operating aisle, U-shaped upper gallery, rear splicing chamber, glazed clerestory and two asymmetric exhaust towers. Units enter and circulate through authored routes; visual dressing never creates navigation or changes training rules.

production_integration.note: Production remains the existing tower module; these anchors do not register a new trainer.

notes: Farm occupies z=0..6; barracks occupies z=7..13. Neither is a scaled master.
Crop beds and livestock pen are decorative occupied cells, not traversable shortcuts.
Roof and upper front framing hide for selected units inside the hall; collision does not change.
Gate visuals follow the same state keys as navigation. Farm and muster gates are independent.
Heavy units can enter the hall but cannot use the loft staircase.

design_intent.summary: Purpose-built compact barracks and fenced provision farm. Each zone is exactly the current laboratory footprint, 9 by 7 cells. The cream stone and timber hall, slate gables, lookout turret and amber lanterns identify the Steel Force. A straight two-cell-wide lane admits heavy cavalry. Room navigation is authored here and is never derived from the skin.

placement.note: Place the entire 9x14 compound; never overlap the farm with another footprint.

production_integration.note: Uses the existing block placement API. No player Steel Force economy or training rules are invented.

world.navigation_rule: Never derive traversability from rendered geometry. Use authored nav regions and links.
world.origin_rule: Structure local origin is minimum x,y,z corner.
world.visual_rule: Geometry, collision and navigation are separate systems.
